limits: Model means unique allocated parameter buffers; tokenizer, Python objects, graphs and driver bookkeeping are outside this component.
MLX active excludes cached buffers. Active plus cache is not the same accounting definition as OS physical footprint.
OS minus MLX is an arithmetic residual; its Python/driver/shared/compressed components were not separately measured.
LLDB getter and CPython measurement calls execute code in the target and briefly pause it; this is not a passive OS memory read.
Python object inspection may have small CPU allocation/page-in effects; the MLX active/cache counters were unchanged.
No future cache-release savings or post-release footprint was measured.
